tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Find AI tools for making video games in QuickMatch's checked list, filtered by category, engine, free plan, starting price and commercial use. Returns up to 10 tools with free plan, price, commercial-use terms, the date prices were checked and a quickmatch.si link. Commercial-use values are shown ex

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Full QuickMatch details for one AI game dev tool: summary, features, free plan, price, starting price, commercial-use terms, engines, exports, the vendor pricing page and the date it was checked. Values are exactly as stored ("checking" means not confirmed yet). Commercial-use values are shown exact

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Side-by-side facts for 2 to 4 AI game dev tools: free plan, price, starting price, commercial use on free and paid plans, engines, exports, last-checked date and links. It doesn't pick a winner. Commercial-use values are shown exactly as stored: yes, no, checking, n/a, limited, attribution.

tools.name: find_skills
tools.description: Find agent skills and MCP servers for game development listed on QuickMatch, filtered by kind, coding agent, engine and words. Returns up to 10 with agents, engines, license, cost, last update and a quickmatch.si link.
